audit_finding: Identified premature claims suggesting that deterministic algorithmic fallback automatically and universally exists offline today without verification of packaged on-device solver logic.

authoritative_capability_taxonomy.AI_AVAILABLE: Remote conversational AI is fully operational via cloud LLM (NETWORK_REQUIRED).
authoritative_capability_taxonomy.AI_DEGRADED: Cloud AI latency high or token budget constrained; simplified extractive summaries returned.
authoritative_capability_taxonomy.DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK_AVAILABLE: Invoked only if an on-device/server-side algorithmic solver is physically packaged and verified in a later implementation wave; not assumed as an automatic offline capability today.
authoritative_capability_taxonomy.AI_UNAVAILABLE: Offline or disconnected with no packaged local solver. Displays transparent notice that AI requires network connectivity.

corrections_applied.change: Updated section 4 capability states to distinguish DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK_AVAILABLE and enforce NETWORK_REQUIRED truth boundary.
Updated section 2.5 to state that offline AI is not automatically guaranteed and local deterministic solvers require packaging verification.
Updated AI Assistant state matrix to require client packaging verification before claiming local fallback.
Updated microcopy to explicitly state: 'AI Assistant requires an internet connection. Browsing the verified Odisha catalog using standard filters.'
